body.html: Tournesol Boutique Hotel sits at 479 Suwannason Road km.5, Aranyaprathet Subdistrict, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo Province — right on a main road, easy to find, about 5 minutes by car from Rong Kluea Market and around 7 minutes from the Khlong Luek border crossing into Poipet on the Cambodian side · It's a boutique hotel of around 51 rooms, designed in a Thai-Bali style with fountains and a garden that gives it a different feel from the usual border-town hotel · TripAdvisor ranks it #3 of 7 hotels in Aranyaprathet, based on dozens of guest reviews.

What gets this place talked about is the outdoor salt-water pool that slopes from shallow to deep and has separate kids' and adults' sections · Many reviews call the pool attractive and clean, and it's a real draw for families with children · Guests also consistently praise the spacious rooms, comfortable beds, and balconies, fridge and flat-screen TV in each room · Staff are friendly and help arrange transport and share border-crossing tips, which matters to travellers stopping over before Cambodia.
"Big, clean room, comfortable bed, lovely pool the kids adored, friendly staff, and close to Rong Kluea Market and the border — perfect for an overnight before crossing into Cambodia."

This place suits an overnight before the border, a day shopping at Rong Kluea Market, or families wanting a pool for the kids more than a long stay · It has an on-site restaurant and cafe, a buffet breakfast that's usually included, free parking, free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk · Nearby there's also Dreamer Water Park, walkable from the hotel, another option for families travelling with children.

To be honest — breakfast and Wi-Fi are where opinions split · Some reviews say breakfast is ordinary, with eggs that can arrive cold and instant coffee, and that the Wi-Fi drops often · A few rooms have drawn reviews about cleanliness in the details, such as bathroom corners, and the AC in some rooms has caused a room change · The hotel's own restaurant is also pricier than places outside, so if you're watching your budget, eating in Aranyaprathet town is better value.

Overall, Tournesol Boutique Hotel works well for families wanting a pool for the kids, couples, or border crossers who want a spacious boutique with a pool at a good price · The overall score of around 8.0 from real reviews reflects exactly what it is — spacious, clean rooms, a standout salt-water pool, friendly staff and a location close to the market and border, traded against breakfast and Wi-Fi that aren't quite settled, and an on-site restaurant pricier than outside · Keep expectations flexible on those points and most guests stay comfortably and feel it's good value.

honestSummary: Tournesol Boutique Hotel is a spacious boutique with a salt-water pool at a good price, ideal for families with children, couples, or travellers crossing into Poipet who want somewhere nicer than the usual border hotel · The trade-off is breakfast and Wi-Fi that aren't quite settled, and an on-site restaurant pricier than places outside.
honestChecks: If breakfast and Wi-Fi matter a lot to you — reviews are split, some find breakfast ordinary and the Wi-Fi drops often → keep expectations flexible, or add a morning coffee spot in Aranyaprathet town.

If you're travelling with kids who love to swim — the salt-water pool with separate kids' and adults' sections is a real highlight → pick a room near the pool and leave the afternoon free for swimming.

If you want a spacious boutique with a pool near Rong Kluea Market on a budget — this delivers well, with roomy, clean rooms and a handy location → it's the best fit for families among Aranyaprathet's boutique stays.

tips.title: Leave the afternoon for the pool

tips.body: Rong Kluea Market and the Khlong Luek border are about 5-7 minutes by car; go in the morning for fewer crowds and cooler air, and have the front desk arrange transport.

faqTitle: FAQ — Tournesol Boutique Hotel, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo

faq.q: Where is Tournesol Boutique Hotel · is it near Rong Kluea Market?
faq.a: It's at 479 Suwannason Road km.5, Aranyaprathet Subdistrict, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo Province, right on a main road and easy to find · about 5 minutes by car from Rong Kluea Market and around 7 minutes from the Khlong Luek border (the crossing into Poipet) · Dreamer Water Park is within walking distance.

faq.q: What's the starting price · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿1,000/night for a Standard Double, which usually includes breakfast · There's also a Standard Twin around ฿1,100, a Deluxe around ฿1,300, and a Family / Suite for families around ฿1,800 · Prices vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does it have a pool · is it good for kids?
faq.a: Yes — an outdoor salt-water pool that slopes from shallow to deep, with separate kids' and adults' sections, a real favourite with families · The pool is clean and well kept, ideal for letting children swim in the afternoon.

faq.q: What are the rooms and breakfast like?
faq.a: Rooms are spacious and clean with comfortable beds, each with a balcony, fridge and flat-screen TV · Breakfast is a buffet usually included with the room, though some reviews call it ordinary, with eggs that can arrive cold and instant coffee, so keep expectations flexible.

faq.q: What are the Wi-Fi and on-site dining like?
faq.a: Wi-Fi is free throughout, but the signal isn't steady at times and drops often · The hotel's own restaurant is pricier than places outside, so if you're watching your budget, eating in Aranyaprathet town or at the market is better value with more choice.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for families wanting a pool for the kids, couples, or travellers crossing into Poipet who want a spacious boutique with a pool at a good price · It suits people who value roomy rooms, a pool and a location near Rong Kluea Market over a fancy breakfast.
